summary: Fixed sign patterns predict all five delivered batch answers without the intended reasoning. Three supplied moderate source banks are also missing. Tested mathematics, grading, rendering and packaging pass. Package unchanged.

source_analysis.skill: Translate a linear system into its augmented matrix.
reasoning_steps: Collect variables on the left and constants on the right.
Identify implicit unit and missing zero coefficients.
Preserve equation order and natural variable order.
Append the constants column and select the matching matrix.
invariants: No equation solving or row reduction.
permitted_variations: Coefficient and constant magnitudes and signs.
Term placement and order within the observed workload.
Distractor error locations and choice positions.

source_replay.details: Seven complete banks replay correctly. Three supplied moderate profiles are rejected.

math.details: Independent integer parsing verified 110 records and three controlled fixtures, including keys, banks and solution matrices.

variety.details: Fixed template sign patterns predict 98/98 independent records, 5/5 delivered batch members and 7/7 stored generated records. Actual learner-policy conclusions remain conditional on uncaptured history and weights.

scope.details: Tested outputs preserve the source method, workload, response contract and solution stages.

grading.details: Native grader accepted 113 correct selections and rejected 452 distractor selections; zero unresolved checks.

rendering.details: Ten actual-UI previews passed. Representative screenshots across all seven profiles and controlled pairs were inspected.

packaging.details: Exact Python dependency matches; deterministic replay and relocation pass. All 102 package files remain unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Selecting the sole negative bottom-right matrix succeeds 28/28 within two recognizable templates. Sign-changing assignments are rejected. Seven historical generated records were exactly reconstructed and confirmed affected.

findings.description: In q-71722 and q-1052, only the correct choice has a negative bottom-right entry. Positive magnitude substitutions preserve this cue throughout each family. A broader memorized template/sign-mask rule also answers every delivered batch member; UI choice shuffling does not remove it.
findings.reproduction: Run the context Python with -B variation_audit.py from evidence_root; it intentionally exits 1. Minimal representative: profile q-71722, seed 941713401, parameters {"2":2,"3":4}, displaying x-4=2y; 1+y=-2x. The correct matrix [[1,-2,4],[2,1,-1]] is the sole choice with a negative bottom-right entry. See minimal-failing-case.json.
findings.requested_change: Allow eligible signed coefficients, constants and answer-bearing placements to vary, deriving the prompt, bank, key and solution together. Preserve source replay while breaking universal corner/sign-mask prediction within recognizable templates. Regenerate the five-question batch.

findings.description: The package omits supplied moderate profiles q-1068, q-1053 and q-129128 despite declaring moderate support.
findings.reproduction: Run the entrypoint with --difficulty moderate --seed 941713201 --template q-1068 --count 1. It raises ValueError: Profile does not belong to requested difficulty. audit.py reproduces all three omissions in source-replay-results.json.
findings.requested_change: Refresh extraction to include all ten supplied assessed questions and reproduce each omitted complete bank, key and worked solution before extending it.
